// LOAD CMS STORIES DYNAMICALLY FROM FOLDER window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => { // We read the dynamic file list generated by Pages CMS/GitHub Pages fetch('/stories/index.json') .catch(() => fetch('/stories/')) // Fallback check .then(response => { if (!response.ok) throw new Error(); return response.json(); }) .then(data => { // Map the folder collection items if (data && data.length > 0) { ceritaDongeng = data.map((item, index) => ({ id: index + 1, title: item.title || "Dongeng Tanpa Tajuk", genre: item.genre || "Fantasi", image: item.image || "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1519681393784-d120267933ba?auto=format&fit=crop&w=800&q=80", excerpt: item.excerpt || "Klik untuk membaca kisah magis ini...", content: item.body ? [item.body] : ["Tiada kandungan."] })); } else { ceritaDongeng = mockStories; } janaKadCerita(ceritaDongeng); }) .catch(err => { console.log("Loading default magical tales:", err); ceritaDongeng = mockStories; janaKadCerita(ceritaDongeng); }); });
